subject: Chemistry
title: Biomolecules (Chemistry)
summary: Carbohydrates polyhydroxy aldehydes (aldose) ya ketones (ketose) hain: monosaccharides (glucose, fructose), disaccharides (sucrose, maltose, lactose) aur polysaccharides (starch, cellulose, glycogen).
Glucose mainly six-membered ring (pyranose) form mein α aur β anomers ke saath rehta hai. Free aldehyde ya ketone group wali sugars reducing hain; sucrose non-reducing hai.
Proteins α-amino acid ke polymers hain jo peptide bonds se jude hain. Structure ke chaar levels hain (primary se quaternary); denaturation upar ke levels todta hai, primary structure nahi.
Nucleic acids (DNA, RNA) nucleotide ke polymers hain — sugar + base + phosphate. Vitamin aur hormone chhote molecules hain jinka biological role bada hai.

formulas.name: Glucose structure evidence
formulas.formula: HI → n-hexane (straight chain);  acetylation → pentaacetate (5 –OH);  HCN → cyanohydrin and NH₂OH → oxime (C=O);  Br₂ water → gluconic acid (–CHO);  HNO₃ → saccharic acid (–CHO and 1° –OH)

formulas.name: Evidence against open chain
formulas.formula: no Schiff's test and no reaction with NaHSO₃;  pentaacetate does not react with NH₂OH;  two anomers (α, β)
formulas.when: Glucose ki ring structure kyun hai.

formulas.name: Anomers and mutarotation
formulas.when: Solution mein specific rotation ka badalna.
formulas.mistake: Anomers sirf C1 par alag hain; ye mirror images nahi hain — galat mat samjho.

formulas.name: Disaccharides and their links
formulas.formula: sucrose = α-glucose (C1) + β-fructose (C2), non-reducing;  maltose = α-glucose C1–C4, reducing;  lactose = β-galactose C1–C4 glucose, reducing

formulas.name: Invert sugar
formulas.formula: sucrose (+66.5°) + H₂O → glucose (+52.5°) + fructose (−92.4°) → mixture is laevorotatory
formulas.when: Hydrolysed sucrose ko invert sugar kyun kehte hain.

formulas.name: Polysaccharides
formulas.formula: starch = amylose (15–20%, unbranched, α-1,4) + amylopectin (80–85%, branched, α-1,6 at branches);  cellulose = β-1,4 glucose;  glycogen = highly branched, like amylopectin
formulas.when: Storage aur structural carbohydrates ki structure.

formulas.name: Peptide bond
formulas.formula: –CO–NH–, formed by condensation of –COOH of one amino acid and –NH₂ of the next; n amino acids → n − 1 peptide bonds

formulas.name: Zwitterion
formulas.formula: H₃N⁺–CHR–COO⁻; at the isoelectric point the net charge is zero
formulas.when: Amino acids ka high melting point aur water-solubility kyun.

formulas.name: Levels of protein structure
formulas.formula: primary (sequence) → secondary (α-helix, β-pleated sheet; H-bonds) → tertiary (overall folding: H-bonds, disulphide, ionic, van der Waals) → quaternary (subunits)

formulas.name: Nucleotide
formulas.formula: nucleoside (base + pentose sugar) + phosphate;  nucleotides joined by 3′–5′ phosphodiester bonds

formulas.name: Bases
formulas.formula: DNA: A, G, C, T;  RNA: A, G, C, U;  purines A, G;  pyrimidines C, T, U;  pairs A=T (2 H-bonds), G≡C (3 H-bonds)

formulas.name: Vitamins and deficiencies
formulas.formula: fat-soluble A, D, E, K;  water-soluble B group and C.  A → night blindness;  B₁ → beri-beri;  B₂ → cheilosis (cracked lips/mouth corners);  B₆ → convulsions;  B₁₂ → pernicious anaemia;  C → scurvy;  D → rickets;  K → delayed blood clotting
formulas.when: Vitamins ko diseases se milaana (fat-soluble vs water-soluble).
formulas.note: B₁₂ water-soluble hai phir bhi liver mein store ho sakta hai — exception yaad rakho.

examples.title: Tripeptides ki ginti
examples.problem: Glycine, alanine aur valine se kitne alag tripeptides (har ek baar-baar use ho sakta hai)?

examples.title: Reducing sugar?
examples.problem: Kaun reducing hain: glucose, fructose, sucrose, maltose, lactose?
examples.solution: Sucrose ke alawa sab. Sucrose mein dono anomeric carbons (glucose ka C1 aur fructose ka C2) glycosidic bond mein lage hain, isliye free hemiacetal group nahi.

examples.title: Denaturation
examples.problem: Anda ubaalne par kya hota hai?
examples.solution: Garmi albumin ko denature karti hai: secondary aur tertiary structures khul jaate hain aur globular protein jam jaata hai. Primary structure (amino acid sequence) nahi badalta.

examples.title: Essential amino acids
examples.problem: Essential aur non-essential amino acids mein farak?
examples.solution: Essential (valine, leucine, isoleucine, lysine, threonine, methionine, phenylalanine, tryptophan, histidine, arginine) khaane se aane chahiye; non-essential (glycine, alanine, glutamic acid) body khud banati hai.

examples.title: DNA vs RNA
examples.problem: DNA aur RNA mein teen farak?
examples.solution: DNA mein deoxyribose, thymine aur double helix; RNA mein ribose, uracil aur aam taur par single strand. DNA genetic information rakhta hai; RNA (m, t, r) protein banane mein madad karta hai.

topics.title: Classification of carbohydrates
topics.explain: Reducing vs non-reducing; aldoses vs ketoses; monosaccharides (hydrolyse nahi hote), oligosaccharides (2–10 units) aur polysaccharides. D/L last chiral carbon ki configuration glyceraldehyde ke relative batata hai, rotation ki direction nahi.

topics.title: Fructose
topics.explain: Ketohexose, laevorotatory; five-membered (furanose) ring banata hai. Tollens' aur Fehling's ko reduce karta hai kyunki alkaline medium mein aldose mein isomerise ho jaata hai. Fruits aur honey mein milta hai; α aur β anomeric forms mein exist karta hai (α-D- aur β-D-fructofuranose).

topics.title: Amino acids
topics.explain: α-Amino acids mein –NH₂ aur –COOH same carbon par. Acidic (aspartic, glutamic), basic (lysine, arginine) aur neutral types. Glycine ke alawa sab optically active aur zyadatar L-configuration.

topics.title: Fibrous and globular proteins
topics.explain: Fibrous proteins (keratin, myosin) lambe, dhaage jaise aur insoluble; globular proteins (insulin, albumin) gol aur water-soluble.

topics.title: Enzymes
topics.explain: Biological catalysts, zyadatar globular proteins, bahut specific; activation energy ghataate hain. Example: maltase maltose ko glucose mein badalta hai.

topics.title: Hormones
topics.explain: Endocrine glands ke chemical messengers: steroid (oestrogen, testosterone), polypeptide (insulin, glucagon) aur amino-acid derivatives (thyroxine, adrenaline). Insulin blood glucose ghataata aur glucagon badhaata hai.

topics.title: Biological functions of nucleic acids
topics.explain: DNA khud ko replicate karta hai aur heredity rakhta hai; transcription se mRNA banta hai, aur ribosomes par translation (tRNA amino acids laata hai) se proteins.

ratta: Sucrose: non-reducing; invert sugar is laevorotatory.
Maltose α-1,4;  lactose β-1,4;  cellulose β-1,4;  amylopectin α-1,6 branches.
